limitations: Runtime is still JS; strict TS/types/emitter attribution are task 04.
Each browser run includes 17 Blob-unavailable controls, not successful Windows WebKit extraction.
Native PNG encoding already submitted cannot itself be aborted; cancellation prevents its late callback effects.
Pre-existing recovered 3.5.31 default differences remain an explicit 04/05 policy gate.
Current coverage policy measures only core/chapter; no thumbnail percentage claimed.
No hosted CI run, next-major version bump, push, tag or npm publication.
